title: VERS: Steering Reasoning Models by Editing Their Activation Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2611.03040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning language models write a chain of thought before they answer, and many checks in it do not change the final answer. Natural language autoencoders (NLAs) explain a model's activations in text and rebuild activations from text, and editing an explanation can steer a model at a single token. We study whether such edits can also steer how a model reasons. We build VERS (Verbalize, Edit, Reconstruct, Steer): it turns explanation edits at the doubt points of one reasoning trace into one fixed direction, and adds this direction at paragraph breaks. On the full GSM8K test, VERS cuts generated tokens by 45.8% at an accuracy change of -0.82 percentage points (pp); on MATH-500 it saves 31.3% at -3.05 pp. At half strength, its trade-off between tokens and accuracy lies between those of the published methods SEAL and DEER. With fitted affine maps and a strength tuned for each model, the direction transfers to larger Qwen3 models, up to 235B-

translated_title: VERS：通过编辑模型的激活解释来引导推理模型
translated_abstract: 推理语言模型在回答之前会先生成一段思维链，其中许多检查步骤并不会改变最终答案。自然语言自编码器（NLA）能用文本解释模型的激活，并能从文本重建激活，而编辑这些解释可以在单个 token 层面对模型进行引导。我们研究这种编辑能否同样引导模型的推理过程。我们构建了 VERS（Verbalize、Edit、Reconstruct、Steer）：它将一条推理轨迹中“疑点”处的解释编辑转化为一个固定的方向，并在段落分隔处添加该方向。在完整的 GSM8K 测试集上，VERS 在准确率仅下降 0.82 个百分点的情况下，将生成的 token 数量减少了 45.8%；在 MATH-500 上，它在准确率下降 3.05 个百分点的情况下节省了 31.3% 的 token。在半强度下，其 token 与准确率之间的权衡介于已发表的方法 SEAL 和 DEER 之间。通过拟合的仿射映射以及针对每个模型调节的强度，该方向可以迁移到更大的 Qwen3 模型上，最大可达 235B。
tldr: VERS 利用自然语言自编码器在推理轨迹的“疑点”处编辑激活解释，将编辑转化为一个固定引导方向并注入到推理段落分隔处，从而在几乎不损失准确率的情况下大幅减少推理模型的生成 token 数量，且该方向可迁移到更大的模型上。
en_tdlr: VERS edits natural-language explanations of a reasoning model's activations at "doubt points," converting the edits into a fixed steering direction applied at paragraph breaks, which cuts generated tokens by up to ~45% on GSM8K with minimal accuracy loss and transfers to larger Qwen3 models.
